articles.headline: A'ja Wilson, Reese, Clark lead AP's WNBA award winners
articles.description: A'ja Wilson is in a class by herself, winning the AP WNBA Player of the Year award for an unprecedented third straight season. Angel Reese dethroned Wilson as Defensive Player of the Year, and Caitlin Clark was named Comeback Player of the Year.

articles.headline: WNBA championship and Finals MVP odds: Lynx head into playoffs as clear favorites
articles.description: The Lynx head into the WNBA playoffs as championship favorites, with Napheesa Collier and Olivia Miles the top picks for Finals MVP.

images.name: Olivia Miles [1296x729]
images.caption: Napheesa Collier, Olivia Miles and the Lynx remain big favorites to win the WNBA championship.
images.alt: Olivia Miles #5 of the Minnesota Lynx reacts to a foul call next to Napheesa Collier #24 during WNBA game against the Golden State Valkyries on August 19, 2026 at Chase Center in San Francisco, CA.

images.name: Napheesa Collier [1296x729]
images.caption: Napheesa Collier and the Lynx enter the week at even money to win the WNBA championship.

images.caption: Napheesa Collier, Natasha Howard and the Minnesota Lynx continue to roll.

images.name: Napheesa Collier [1296x729]
images.caption: Napheesa Collier's welcome return only boosts a Lynx team that's the current favorite to win the WNBA Finals.
images.alt: Napheesa Collier #24 of the Minnesota Lynx shoots a free throw during the game against the Seattle Storm on July 22, 2026 at Climate Pledge Arena in Seattle, Washington.

images.name: Olivia Miles for Odds File (260720) [1296x729]

articles.headline: Atlanta clinches the No. 4 seed as Angel Reese exits after a hit to the face in win over Liberty
articles.description: — Allisha Gray scored 24 points, Naz Hillmon added 16 and Atlanta secured the No. 4 seed in the playoffs with an 83-65 victory over the New York Liberty on Wednesday night to close out the regular season for both teams.

articles.headline: Dream's Reese OK after being struck in face; Liberty C Jones tweaks ankle
articles.description: Dream star Angel Reese was fine after leaving Wednesday's game against the Liberty after being struck in the face just before halftime. The Liberty's Jonquel Jones also left the game after suffering a second-half ankle injury.

articles.headline: Angel Reese has 30 points and 10 rebounds to help the Dream rout the Sun 103-59
articles.description: — Angel Reese scored 30 points on 11-of-14 shooting and had 10 rebounds to help the Atlanta Dream rout the Connecticut Sun 103-59 on Thursday night in the first WNBA game following a nearly three-week break for the FIBA World Cup.
